newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA-BIRZAI MILK APRIL SALES UP TO 8.1 MLN LITAS.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA-BIRZAI MILK APRIL SALES UP TO 8.1 MLN LITAS.

text.p: Lithuania's Birzai Milk dairy firm said on Tuesday that its sales in April rose slightly to 8.1 million litas from 7.9 million litas in March.
The increase in sales was due to a new low fat yogurt for women launched by the company last month, Vladas Songaila, the director general of the company told Reuters.
He also said the firm expected its sales to grow gradually in the next two months and to increase more rapidly in July.
The company is now listed on the A group of the Vilnius bourse but from May 12 it will enter the official list of the bourse.
